title: SignerList
key_points: SignerList is a ledger transaction type that represents the list of accounts designated as signers for a trust line or account.
It contains an array of Account ID objects, each representing a signer account.
The SignerList allows for multiple accounts to be designated as signers on a trust line or account.
When the SignerList is modified, a SignerListSet transaction is created on the ledger.
The SignerList can only be modified by accounts that have control over the trust line or account.
limitations: The information provided is specific to the XRP Ledger and may not apply to other blockchain systems or digital currencies.
The documentation assumes familiarity with concepts related to the XRP Ledger, such as trust lines and accounts.
The effectiveness of using SignerList may depend on the proper setup and maintenance of trust lines and accounts within the XRP Ledger.
asserts: SignerList is a crucial ledger transaction type in the XRP Ledger that enables multiple accounts to be designated as signers for a trust line or account, ensuring secure control and modifications.
scope: The scope of this documentation is to provide information on how SignerList works within the context of the XRP Ledger, focusing on its role in managing trust lines and accounts.
